observer.persistence: immediately previous endpoint; representative direction identical; shared arm; inclusive intersection/shorter >=0.5
observer.signed_trigger: both confidence lags have same sign and abs(lag)>2; difference<=2; original reliability/common-support gain>.5
observer.component_rule: Original interval-overlap connected components, including opposite signs; strongest minimum absolute error reduction representative; no direction split

actuator.query_support: union of observed physical intervals mapped by H3 nominal time bins, all spatial rows

prefix.eligibility: Current Native n remains comparable through firstON n inclusive. Chosen n is comparable strictly before firstON. Full n and all future historical Native endpoints permanently N/A after firstON, including later OFF.
prefix.all_OFF: Compare actual R47 Native and final AV; decoded RGB measured separately.
prefix.available_mismatch: Abort and retain evidence on eligible current Native mismatch. No deferred first intervention or extra replay.
prefix.same_state: Every current Native/Full pair shares exact packedinput/sigma/condition; RNG and parent resident state unchanged.
prefix.historical_limit: R47 archived eight clean condition entities, exact noise, all21 AV endpoints; full processed/postaugmentation tree and packed sampler inputs absent.
prefix.availability: Actual completed R47 archive and final source pose binding.

efficiency: record native/full, snapshots, isolated decoder load/decode/IO, CPU lock wait, pose+scan, total; no speed optimization

inherited_rule.policy_change: signed candidate eligibility and same-direction persistence only

evaluation.main: all186 full-source scan rows with UNKNOWN retained; same Native/Auto common support
evaluation.purpose: multiple-case improvement relative to Native, approaching manual/fixed controls; no requirement to outperform manual or global
evaluation.source_scope: Gym dance identity editing; both advancement/delay and UNKNOWN remain visible; arms-only observer.
